english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when the context makes clear that you mean one item of clothing.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for clothing in casual Hong Kong Cantonese, though context can narrow it to a shirt or top.
Use this for clothing generally; a sports strip is more specifically called 球衣.
